quality.coverage: Curated core/general-purpose language and coding milestones, public API launches, open-weight releases, and announced capability updates. Not an exhaustive model catalogue.
quality.datePolicy: Dated first-party announcement; official repository dated News when no separate dated announcement is needed. API and later open-weight releases are separate distribution milestones.
quality.grouping: Models released together in one dated family/size announcement count as one event. Quantizations, silent file commits, previews, and specialized image/audio/Omni/VL-only/robotics/embedding/safety families are excluded.
quality.automation: Manually source-checked snapshot. No automatic announcement discovery.
quality.forecastGrouping: Each model type has its own dated history. A batch belongs only to the types released or updated that day, not earlier models or coming-soon previews mentioned in the evidence. Coding sizes are separate from core sizes. Same-day entries count once per type. Generation counts the first public launch of each numbered generation, including 3.5, 3.6, 3.7 and 3.8, whether it launches through an API or open weights. Later tiers, sizes and distribution milestones stay in their own type histories and do not count as another generation. New models are releases; only changes to existing models are updates. Unspecified sizes are not inferred.
